en.headline: Observatory issues morning thunderstorm warning for New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 6:10am, valid until 8:30am, for isolated storms over the New Territories.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a thunderstorm warning at 6:10am on Friday, valid until 8:30am, saying isolated thunderstorms were expected over the New Territories.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek shelter, to leave the water and not to swim or take part in other outdoor water sports, and to stay off high ground and away from conductive objects, trees and masts.

At 6am the Observatory recorded 29 degrees at its headquarters, with relative humidity at 81 per cent. Its 6:05am nine-day forecast said a northeast monsoon would bring more cloud, showers and thunderstorms to south China today and on Saturday, with Friday's temperature around 27 to 31 degrees and a high chance of significant rain. Heavier rain was expected in some areas, with sunny periods at times.

zh.headline: 天文台早上發出雷暴警告 新界局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台上午6時10分發出雷暴警告，有效至上午8時30分，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台星期五上午6時10分發出雷暴警告，有效至上午8時30分，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。
天文台提醒，身在戶外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，不要在戶外游泳或做其他水上活動，亦不要站在高地，並遠離導電物體、樹木和桅杆。
上午6時，天文台總部錄得氣溫29度，相對濕度81%。上午6時05分的九天天氣預報指，東北季候風今明兩日影響華南，雲量增多，有驟雨及雷暴。星期五氣溫約27至31度，顯著降雨概率高，部分地區雨勢較大，日間部分時間天色明朗。
